steps.description: Build an integer count matrix (genes as rows, 12 samples as columns) from counts.csv and join metadata.csv for the condition factor. Set the reference level of condition explicitly to 'control' (do not rely on alphabetical ordering) so a positive log2 fold change means higher expression in treated; name the contrast as condition, treated vs control. Construct a DESeqDataSet with design ~ condition and run DESeq()'s Wald test; do not pre-normalize or pre-scale the counts, since DESeq2's median-of-ratios size factors handle library-size differences (including sample_01's low depth) inside the model. Because the input is already a gene-summarized Salmon count table (not per-sample transcript quant.sf files), no tximport transcript-length offset is available or applied; state this as a limitation. plan.title: Heart treated vs control DESeq2 DE + pathway enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: The data are raw gene-level Salmon counts for 12 heart samples (6 treated, 6 control, unpaired, single batch, 12000 x 12 after dropping the gene-symbol column), with total-RNA/rRNA-depleted libraries and a sequencing QC flag of >60% duplication in most libraries plus sample_01 at ~4x below median library size. Because only the gene-level count matrix and sample table are available (no FASTQ/BAM/alignment records), duplication rate and strandedness cannot be independently recomputed here and are carried forward as inherited caveats rather than re-derived; per-sample library size, detected-gene count, and mitochondrial/rRNA read-fraction proxies can be computed from the matrix itself and are used for QC instead. The plan follows the standard small-cohort bulk RNA-seq path: (1) sample-structure QC (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap, library-size/detected-gene/MT-fraction/rRNA-fraction table) that surfaces sample_01 without silently dropping it; (2) a minimal count pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, the smallest group) followed by DESeq2 Wald testing with an explicit control-reference factor level and apeglm log2FC shrinkage, since size factors (not pre-scaling) handle the depth imbalance and duplicate reads are kept because there are no UMIs to prove they are non-biological; (3) an edgeR quasi-likelihood cross-check on the same filtered matrix and design, with the DESeq2/edgeR intersection reported as the high-confidence gene set, because at 6 replicates/group the two tools can disagree; (4) fgsea preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark, Reactome (filtered to Homo sapiens), and WikiPathways human collections from the reference store, each with its own BH correction, 15-500 gene-set-size window, and leading-edge genes reported, because with a small cohort a coordinated-but-subtle pathway signal is more robust than a hard gene-level cutoff; (5) a consolidated report with fit diagnostics, reproducibility record, and all caveats stated. No translational/PK/safety steps are added because the research question is a plain two-group differential expression question with no drug, biomarker, or clinical-outcome component.

steps.name: Consolidated DE and enrichment report
steps.question: What is the final, reproducible summary of genes differing between treated and control heart samples, the confidence in that gene list, the pathways it implicates, and the caveats from the QC (low-depth sample, high duplication, no strandedness verification)?
steps.description: Assemble a single report combining: the QC findings from T1S1 (library sizes, detected genes, MT/rRNA fractions, PCA/distance heatmap, sample_01 disposition, duplication/strandedness caveats stated as inherited limitations); the DESeq2 results from T1S2 (design formula ~condition, contrast treated vs control with control as reference, pre-filter threshold, alpha=0.05, number of genes tested after filtering, number of DE genes at padj<0.05, MA plot, dispersion plot, p-value histogram, NA-gene breakdown); the edgeR cross-check from T1S3 (significant gene counts per method, intersection size, high-confidence gene set); and the fgsea enrichment results from T2S1 (per-collection significant pathways, leading-edge genes, collection versions). State package versions (DESeq2, apeglm, edgeR, fgsea) and record the analysis session information and any random seeds used. Explicitly restate that the study is unpaired, single-batch, 6-vs-6, and that all findings are conditional on the caveats already logged (duplication without UMIs, sample_01's depth, no independent strandedness check).
acceptance_criteria: Report states design formula, contrast, reference level, thresholds, number of tested genes, and number of DE genes
Report states the DESeq2/edgeR intersection size and names it as the high-confidence gene set
Report includes fit diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion plot, p-value histogram) and enrichment results with collection versions and leading-edge genes
Report explicitly restates the QC caveats (sample_01 depth, duplication rate, strandedness) and how each was handled
Report includes package versions and session information for reproducibility
steps.context: Final synthesis step combining outputs of T1S1, T1S2, T1S3, and T2S1 for the 6 treated vs 6 control heart RNA-seq comparison.
constraints: Do not present the union of DESeq2 and edgeR gene lists as the finding; use the stated intersection as high-confidence and list method-unique genes separately
